Mostra um cartão visual (widget) na conv: Shows a visual card (widget) in the conversation. Use it when it helps more than text: prices to compare, places on a map, the layout of a room or a simple diagram, a chart, picks of series, movies, games or books, a side-by-side comparison, a timeline or a checklist. Prices, ratings and data must come from what you actually found (search the web first) and state the date you saw them; never invent a product link: without the right link, leave it out. After the widget, don't repeat in the text what it already shows; comment only on what helps the person decide.
Os dados, no formato do tipo. produtos:: The data, in the shape of the tipo. Field names stay as written here. produtos: {itens: [{nome, preco (number), moeda (default BRL), loja (store), link?, nota? (rating, 0 to 5), observacao? (note), imagem? (https)}], visto_em: "YYYY-MM-DD" (when you saw the prices)}. mapa: {pontos: [{nome, descricao?, lat, lon} or {nome, descricao?, endereco (address)}], rota?: true to connect the points in order}. recomendacoes: {itens: [{titulo, tipo (serie, filme, jogo, anime, livro, musica, podcast or outro), ano? (year), generos: [] (genres), onde? (where to watch, play or listen), duracao? (length), nota?: {valor, fonte} (rating and its source), por_que (why it fits), imagem?}]}. desenho: {largura (width), altura (height), unidade (m, cm or px), formas: [{tipo, coordinates, rotulo? (label), cor? (color), preenchido? (filled)}], legenda?: [{cor, rotulo}]}, with the origin at the top left corner, y going down and everything in the chosen unit; coordinates of each shape tipo: retangulo x, y, largura, altura, rotacao?; circulo x, y, raio (radius); linha and seta (arrow) x1, y1, x2, y2; texto x, y, texto; poligono pontos: [[x, y], ...]; cota (dimension line) x1, y1, x2, y2, deslocamento? (how far to move the dimension line out of the drawing; the length is written on its own). grafico: {tipo_grafico (barras, linhas, pizza or area), rotulos: [] (labels), series: [{nome, valores: []}], unidade?}. comparacao: {colunas: [] (what is compared), linhas: [{criterio, valores: [], melhor?: index of the best column}]}. linha_do_tempo: {eventos: [{data, titulo, descricao?}]}. checklist: {itens: [{texto, feito?}]}. Colors (cor): acao (teal), azul (blue), verde (green), vermelho (red), laranja (orange), amarelo (yellow), roxo (purple), rosa (pink), marrom (brown), cinza (gray) and preto (black); the English names also work.
